Re: Appeal of prior authorization denial for cervical fusion  
Member: Rowan Delgado  
Member ID: W865123628  
Plan: Blue Cross Blue Shield of North Dakota Commercial/ACA  
Reference number: POC-9391F374E1-41425  
Requested service: Anterior cervical discectomy and fusion at C5-C6  
CPT: 22551

Dear Member Appeals Reviewer:

I am appealing the denial of prior authorization for the requested C5-C6 anterior cervical discectomy and fusion. The denial notice dated August 18, 2026 states that the procedure does not meet the plan’s criteria for medical necessity. I request that Blue Cross Blue Shield of North Dakota overturn the denial and authorize the surgery based on the documented symptoms, objective neurologic findings, imaging, and failure of extensive conservative treatment.

I have experienced progressive neck pain for 14 months. The pain has not been relieved by rest. I also have radicular pain and numbness extending into my right thumb and index finger, together with weakness. Examination documented positive provocative testing on the affected side and a neurologic deficit corresponding to the affected cervical level.

The MRI performed on June 26, 2026 provides objective anatomic confirmation of the clinical findings. It shows a C5-C6 disc herniation with severe right foraminal narrowing and compression of the C6 nerve root. The right-sided symptoms, sensory changes, weakness, examination findings, and MRI findings are consistent with one another and identify a specific surgically treatable source of the neurologic impairment.

I have also completed substantial nonoperative treatment without adequate relief:

- Supervised physical therapy, including cervical traction and postural training, for eight weeks from May 18, 2026 through July 13, 2026, with 18 visits completed. The treatment and outcome are documented in the physical therapy discharge note.
- NSAID treatment for eight months, with inadequate relief.
- A corticosteroid injection on May 8, 2026, which provided only three weeks of partial relief.

These records demonstrate persistent and progressive symptoms despite appropriate conservative care. The continued radicular pain, numbness, and weakness, together with objective C6 nerve-root compression, support the medical necessity of surgical decompression and fusion at C5-C6.

The record also does not identify a documented clinical barrier to surgery. I have no active infection, no untreated substance-use disorder, and I am a nonsmoker. My BMI is 29. The requested procedure was submitted by Marchetti, MD, an orthopedic surgeon, for treatment of the documented C5-C6 pathology and associated neurologic deficit.

The denial notice does not identify the specific medical-policy provision, clinical-review criterion, documentation deficiency, or factual finding that led to the denial. I was unable to retrieve the governing BCBSND policy text for this request. Accordingly, this appeal does not quote or reconstruct any BCBSND policy language. Please provide the complete policy and clinical-review criteria applied to CPT 22551, including the policy title, policy number, version or effective date, and the precise reason the submitted records were considered insufficient.

Please review the enclosed prior authorization materials, including:

- The June 26, 2026 cervical MRI report;
- The physical therapy discharge note documenting 18 visits from May 18 through July 13, 2026;
- Records documenting eight months of NSAID treatment;
- The May 8, 2026 corticosteroid-injection record and limited response;
- Examination findings showing positive provocative testing, weakness, and a corresponding neurologic deficit;
- The orthopedic surgical evaluation and recommendation from Marchetti, MD; and
- Any additional clinical records submitted with the original authorization request.

Based on the duration and progression of symptoms, failure of conservative treatment, objective C5-C6 structural disease, severe right foraminal narrowing, C6 nerve-root compression, and corresponding neurologic impairment, I respectfully request that BCBSND reverse the denial and approve CPT 22551.

If BCBSND maintains the denial, please provide a detailed written explanation identifying each unmet criterion, the specific medical records relied upon, the clinical reviewer’s rationale, and the applicable appeal rights. Please also advise whether any additional information is needed from my surgeon.

This appeal must be received by February 14, 2027. Please confirm receipt of this appeal and notify me of the determination.

Sincerely,

Rowan Delgado  
Member ID: W865123628  
Reference number: POC-9391F374E1-41425

Enclosures: Clinical records listed above
